rationale: The plan treats the design correctly as a 2x2 factorial, fits ~condition + time + condition:time with time as a two-level factor (explicitly rejecting time_hours), tests the interaction coefficient by Wald as the primary result, and reports the two simple effects with ashr shrinkage and an edgeR QL F-test as a robustness check. Reference levels, the filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, tied to the smallest group), in-model median-of-ratios normalization, BH at 0.05 with independent filtering, and lfcThreshold-in-test rather than post hoc are all stated. QC is blind VST PCA plus distance heatmap coloured by condition and time with library sizes and a flag-only policy; the downstream handling of a flagged outlier beyond Cook's flagging is only lightly specified. Enrichment is correctly omitted with a stated reason, and the report record covers method, versions, design, contrasts, thresholds, counts, power and length-offset caveats, and sessionInfo.
